description: Fields of the cycle record (state.md#2.8), cycles/<cycle>/cycle.json.

id.description: Slug of 2 to 40 lower-case characters, chosen when the cycle opens.

route.description: standard from the opening when a brief opens the cycle; written by vsdd feature route when a change request opened it; empty for a maintenance cycle.

baseline.description: A release tag, an ingest or an import; empty for a first release.

request.description: brief, or the id of the one request file, CR-<NNN>.

version.description: Added once closed by the release checkpoint: the release version.

archive_commit.description: Added once closed: the commit of the state branch just before pruning.
